tavily.label: Tavily
tavily.note: Search API built for agents; returns clean article summaries. 1,000 free requests per month.

duckduckgo.label: DuckDuckGo
duckduckgo.note: No key needed, works out of the box (HTML parsing; average result quality, zero config and cost).

searxng.label: SearXNG (self-hosted)
searxng.note: Self-hosted metasearch. Enter your instance URL in the advanced field; the instance must enable JSON output.

brave.label: Brave Search
brave.note: Independent index; 2,000 free requests per month.

exa.label: Exa
exa.note: Semantic search, great for technical docs and papers.

bing.label: Bing Search
bing.note: Azure Cognitive Services; requires a subscription key.

google.label: Google CSE
google.note: Requires a Programmable Search Engine ID (cx) in addition to the API key.

baidu.label: Baidu
baidu.note: Parses web results without a key; Baidu's anti-bot measures may cause occasional failures (automatically falls back to the next provider).
